name: Adrenorphin
summary: Adrenorphin, also sometimes referred to as metorphamide, is an endogenous, C-terminally amidated, opioid octapeptide (Tyr-Gly-Gly-Phe-Met-Arg-Arg-Val-NH2, YGGFMRRV-NH2) that is produced from proteolytic cleavage of proenkephalin A and is widely distributed throughout the mammalian brain.

pharmacology.text: Adrenorphin exhibits potent opioid activity, acting as a balanced μ- and κ-opioid receptor agonist while having no effects on δ-opioid receptors.

uses.en: It is studied in the laboratory as one of the body's own opioid peptides. It is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它在實驗室中作為人體自身的鴉片類胜肽被研究，並不是藥品。
uses.zhHans: 它在实验室中作为人体自身的鸦片类胜肽被研究，并不是药品。

fact.en: It is a peptide the body makes itself, eight amino acids long, cut from the same precursor protein as the enkephalins. Its first five amino acids are exactly those of met-enkephalin.
fact.zh: 它是身體自行製造的胜肽，由八個胺基酸組成，從與腦啡（enkephalin）相同的前驅蛋白切割而來。它前五個胺基酸與met-enkephalin完全相同。
fact.zhHans: 它是身体自行制造的胜肽，由八个胺基酸组成，从与脑啡（enkephalin）相同的前驱蛋白切割而来。它前五个胺基酸与met-enkephalin完全相同。
